title: Implement Tiered Transaction Fee System in MediTrade Pulse
description: MediTrade Pulse is a simplified fintech trading platform written in TypeScript. Currently, all transactions are free. To create a new revenue stream, the business wants to introduce a dynamic transaction fee. This task requires implementing this new fee system across the application, from configuration to core logic and testing. The implementation will be broken down into three distinct sessions to simulate an agile development sprint, testing the agent's ability to maintain context and build upon previous work.

project_spec.name: MediTrade Pulse
project_spec.description:
MediTrade Pulse is a lightweight TypeScript-based trading platform that enables hospital groups and healthcare insurers to exchange, hedge, and audit the purchase of medical-grade commodities (e.g., PPE futures, pharmaceutical options) in multiple currencies. By embedding automated risk-assessment rules that reflect clinical supply-chain constraints (expiry dates, batch recalls, patient-safety grades) the system guarantees that trades comply with healthcare regulations while still behaving like a modern fintech engine.

Built around a strict hexagonal architecture, the core domain models—Orders, Portfolios, RiskScores, and ClinicalComplianceFlags—are completely isolated from I/O concerns. Adapters on the outside handle REST/GraphQL APIs for hospital ERPs, HL7/FHIR message subscriptions, and secure WebSocket feeds from external exchanges. Event Sourcing ensures every clinically relevant state change (e.g., a temperature excursion for a vaccine batch) is immutable, auditable, and replayable for FDA inspections. Saga-orchestrated workflows coordinate cross-currency settlements, encryption services, and pharmacy-level inventory updates without locking the core.

Although the platform reuses familiar fintech primitives (trades, ledgers, settlement), its value proposition is strictly healthcare: clinicians gain real-time visibility into risk-weighted inventory positions, while finance teams obtain compliant, multi-currency reporting that satisfies both IFRS and HIPAA audit trails.
dependencies: TypeORM or Prisma (for relational projections/read models)
class-validator + class-transformer (DTO validation for clinical data)
uuid (deterministic UUIDv5 for medical device traceability)
